captions: Presentation captions over actual local application responses. Pairing credentials excluded; fictional data and simulated inbox.

chapters.title: FollowDesk / Reviewed sales outreach
chapters.body: Independent software prototype: existing CRM enquiry → reviewed message → simulated inbox → recorded outcome. Fictional data throughout.

chapters.title: 01 / Start with the existing enquiry
chapters.body: Live, limited LoopDesk access reads the current contact and scope last received by the CRM. Enrolment does not send anything.

chapters.title: 02 / Edit the message with its context visible
chapters.body: The plan version is pinned. Original CRM next action and received-scope identity remain visible. Internal review does not mean customer acceptance.

chapters.title: 03 / Confirm the exact saved snapshot
chapters.body: Recipient, content, schedule and live CRM context are checked. A changed draft or recipient invalidates the review; unsaved text cannot silently replace it.

chapters.title: 04 / One safe, immutable delivery receipt
chapters.body: Delivery writes a receipt, advances the step and queues CRM history together. This built-in inbox is simulated: no real email is sent.

chapters.title: 05 / A reply stops future work
chapters.body: The synthetic reply cancels pending steps while preserving the delivered message. Opt-outs also suppress matching contacts and destinations.

chapters.title: 06 / Outcomes stay separate from CRM delivery
chapters.body: Counts come from immutable events. Two history events await acknowledgement; retrying CRM synchronisation never repeats the message.

chapters.title: 07 / Real CRM history, repeat-safe updates
chapters.body: LoopDesk receives exactly one delivery and one reply event. Its stage, owner, value, next action and tasks are preserved.

chapters.title: Local demonstration / verified boundaries
chapters.body: Real local apps and SQLite data; explicitly simulated message transport. PostgreSQL, production vault dependencies and hosted HTTPS still require verification.
